description:
Fancy a light puzzle with a splash of holiday glamour?

Set around resort pools, this photo puzzle lets you enjoy swimsuit shots of beautiful women with a variety of looks and moods.

Take in the bright resort atmosphere as you complete each simple photo puzzle. The expressive faces, styles and summer fashion are all part of the fun.

How to play:
・Study the photo of the beautiful woman
・Rotate the sliced pieces to complete the picture
・Take your time enjoying the finished swimsuit photo

With refreshing poolside scenes and an open resort feel, each puzzle is made for relaxed play. There are no complicated rules to learn, so it is easy to dip in during a spare moment or unwind at your own pace.

Recommended for players who:
・Like games themed around beautiful women
・Enjoy swimsuit and resort-style visuals
・Want a casual photo puzzle
・Are looking for something quick to play
・Prefer playing solo at a relaxed pace

Complete your favourite shots and enjoy a breezy resort photo puzzle experience!
